items.title: Large Language Models for Structured Information Extraction from German Histopathology Reports - Hepatocellular Carcinoma
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Clinical registries and institutional quality control (QC) in pathology heavily depend on complex histopathological data. However, critical tumor characteristics are mostly locked in unstructured free-text reports. We hypothesize that locally deployed, resource-efficient language models operating within a secure institutional network can reliably extract relevant variables from German reports of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), thereby enabling automated data curation without transferring sensitive patient data. Methods: We developed a local, privacy-preserving open-weight Large Language Model (LLM) pipeline consisting of two consecutive stages: Stage 1 utilizes a lightweight gatekeeper model to isolate the target cohort of confirmed Hepatocellular Carcinoma cases from a screening pool of N = 2,864 reports. Stage 2 deploys a high-capacity model to extract 15 predefined histopathological variables, including tumor-node-metastasis staging, histological grading, vascular invasion, and selected immunohistochemical features into structured JSON format. For both Stages, pipeline performance was evaluated using Accuracy, Macro F1-scores, and Cohen's kappa compared to expert-curated reference annotations. Results: The top-performing Stage 1 gatekeeper isolated the target patient cohort with zero classification errors, effectively reaching complete agreement with the reference standard (ground truth) and correcting inaccurate administrative metadata. For Stage 2 feature extraction, current-generation models demonstrated robust structural reliability, reducing the burden of manual post-processing. The 31B model configuration (Gemma 4) virtually eliminated objective factual errors, achieving near-perfect agreement with the reference standard (Macro F1 > 0.99). Conclusion: Local two-stage pipelines offer a highly accurate, resource-efficient, and secure solution for clinical text processing. This framework serves as a privacy-preserving engine for institutional quality control and the scalable curation of pathology registries.
items.summary_zh: 本地两阶段开源权重 LLM 在 2,864 份德语病理报告中提取 HCC 结构化变量，报告 Macro F1 > 0.99。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 面向隐私敏感病理登记和质控的本地化工作流；需注意单机构、专家标注参照及前印本阶段的泛化风险。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：病理学中的临床登记和机构质量控制（QC）高度依赖复杂的组织病理学数据。然而，关键肿瘤特征大多被锁定在非结构化自由文本报告中。我们假设，在安全的机构网络内运行、资源高效的本地部署语言模型，能够从肝细胞癌（HCC）德语报告中可靠提取相关变量，从而无需转移敏感患者数据即可实现自动数据整理。方法：我们开发了一个本地、保护隐私的开放权重大语言模型（LLM）流水线，包含连续两个阶段：阶段 1 使用轻量级 gatekeeper 模型，从 N = 2,864 份报告的筛选池中分离出已确诊肝细胞癌的目标队列。阶段 2 部署高容量模型，将包括肿瘤-淋巴结-转移分期、组织学分级、血管侵犯和部分免疫组化特征在内的 15 项预定义组织病理学变量提取为结构化 JSON 格式。两个阶段的流水线性能均以 Accuracy、Macro F1 分数和 Cohen's kappa 评估，并与专家整理的参考标注比较。结果：表现最佳的阶段 1 gatekeeper 在分离目标患者队列时没有分类错误，实际上与参考标准（ground truth）完全一致，并纠正了不准确的行政元数据。对于阶段 2 特征提取，当代模型表现出稳健的结构可靠性，减少了人工后处理负担。31B 模型配置（Gemma 4）几乎消除了客观事实错误，与参考标准达到近乎完全的一致性（Macro F1 > 0.99）。结论：本地两阶段流水线为临床文本处理提供了高准确度、资源高效且安全的解决方案。该框架可作为保护隐私的引擎，用于机构质量控制和病理登记的可扩展整理。
items.author_line: Koch, N., Hartmann, N., Maennel, A., Baretton, G., Aust, D., Hoenscheid, P.

items.title: NOMOS: Compiling Written Policies into Statically Verified Tool-Call Gates for LLM Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Tool-using LLM agents violate the policies they are deployed to enforce, often silently. Prior defenses hand-write rules, query an LLM verifier per action, or compile policies through heavyweight formal machinery. Naive compilation fails: extracted rules block the tool satisfying their own precondition, or read arguments their tool lacks. NOMOS, a four-pass compiler, turns a natural-language policy into a deterministic tool-call gate; static verification with tool-schema-level checks alone (no prover, solver, or LLM) repairs or rejects 37% (airline) and 13% (retail) of candidates, without which most shipped rules are inoperable. Replaying compiled rules over undefended transcripts flags bindings that refuse legitimate work (a development binding refused 95.9% of task-passing calls); no evaluation binding is flagged. On τ^2-bench the gate cuts violations of reference-encoded clauses among state-changing calls from 66.3% to 2.6% (airline) and 30.8% to 6.9% (retail), raising airline task success significantly for 2 \le k \le 4; a 26B on-premise compilation is not significantly worse than hand-written or frontier-compiled rules. Unlike AgentDojo's shipped defenses, it reaches a zero attack success rate (ASR) on banking, where nine attack families collapse onto three structural rules. On the other three suites its ASR is at most 3.6%, from goals with no tool call to govern and one write admitted by a binding weaker than its clause; a second agent model, Llama-3.3-70B, reproduces the effect on both benchmarks. Decisions take microseconds without an LLM call, at a domain-dependent benign-utility cost; compilation runs on-premise on open-weight gemma-4-26B.
items.summary_zh: NOMOS 将自然语言政策编译为确定性的工具调用闸门，并以工具模式级静态检查修复或拒绝不可操作规则；在多个基准上报告了违规率、攻击成功率和正常任务效用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把策略文本转为可静态检查的执行约束，且报告了安全性与正常效用之间的权衡，为智能体工具调用的可验证防护提供了可复现的评测对象。
items.abstract_zh: 使用工具的 LLM 智能体会违反其被部署来执行的政策，而且往往悄无声息。已有防御要么手写规则，要么对每次行动查询 LLM 验证器，要么通过重量级形式化机制编译政策。朴素编译会失败：提取出的规则会阻止满足其自身前置条件的工具，或者读取该工具不具备的参数。NOMOS 是一个四遍编译器，它将自然语言政策转换为确定性的工具调用闸门；仅用工具模式级检查进行静态验证（不使用证明器、求解器或 LLM），即可修复或拒绝 37%（航空）和 13%（零售）的候选规则；若无此步骤，大多数已交付规则都无法运行。在无防御的转录记录上回放已编译规则，可标出会拒绝正当工作的绑定（一个开发绑定拒绝了 95.9% 的通过任务调用）；没有评测绑定被标出。在 τ²-bench 上，该闸门将改变状态调用中违反参考编码条款的比例从 66.3% 降至 2.6%（航空），从 30.8% 降至 6.9%（零售），并在 2 ≤ k ≤ 4 时显著提高航空任务成功率；一个 26B 本地部署的编译模型并不显著差于手写规则或前沿模型编译的规则。与 AgentDojo 随附的防御不同，它在银行业务中达到零攻击成功率（ASR），其中九个攻击族归并为三条结构规则。在另外三个套件中，其 ASR 至多为 3.6%，这些攻击来自没有工具调用可约束的目标，以及一个允许了比其条款更弱写入的绑定；第二个智能体模型 Llama-3.3-70B 在两个基准上复现了该效果。决策无需 LLM 调用、耗时微秒，但会带来依领域而异的正常效用成本；编译可在开源权重 gemma-4-26B 上本地运行。
items.author_line: Min-Young Yu, Tony Kim, Jang Won Choi

items.title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
items.abstract_or_text: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate completedmodels model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 AAArena：在固定比赛与评测预算下，智能体需解读规则、分析回放并修改可执行游戏策略；在 12 个真实对抗游戏及 1,920 个历史人类程序上评测多种配置。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它以长期、资源受限的竞赛排名衡量智能体从经验修改策略的能力，并显示已评测系统尚未在全部人类梯队中夺冠。
items.abstract_zh: 对抗游戏推动了从启发式搜索到强化学习的进步，但从有限样本中学习和调整策略仍具挑战。AI 智能体提供了另一种途径：将游戏经验转化为对可执行策略的修订。基于启发式学习（HL），我们形式化了对抗式启发式学习（AHL）：一种使用 AI 智能体作为学习引擎来改进游戏策略和支持软件、同时保持模型权重固定的范式。我们提出 AAArena，这是一个由 12 个真实对抗游戏和 1,920 个归档人类程序构成的基准，其评测协议仿照现实游戏竞赛。智能体解读规则、选择对手、分析回放，并修订游戏智能体，以在固定比赛和评测预算内获得最高排名。我们评测了已完成的模型与运行框架配置：Opus5.5 搭配 Claude Code 获得 6 枚金牌，而没有任何已评测配置在其余 6 个由人类占据的梯队中登顶。在规则规格更复杂的游戏中，性能通常更弱。进一步实验显示，对手选择和密集反馈有助于策略改进；智能体既能从自身比赛的在策略回放中学习，也能从其他玩家比赛的离策略回放中学习。这些结果凸显了 HL 在对抗游戏中的潜力，并指出游戏理解、策略实现和长期策略开发仍面临持续挑战。
items.author_line: Kaisen Yang, Qingle Liu, Kejin Wang, Yicheng Zhao, Jieming Li, Shenghan Zheng, Ruize Yang, Bojun Yang, Heng Gong, Xiang Gao, Lanyue Zhang, Kaiyu Zhong, Zhuo Liu, Shaoxuan Li, Chengxi Li, Yong Yan, Weixuan Zhang, Tianwei Luo, Situ Wang, Youjie Zheng, Sihan Zhao, Shengyuan Wang, Huan-ang Gao, Jiazheng Xu, Xiaohui Xie, Wentao Han, Hongning Wang

items.title: A 3D Characterization Framework for Intelligent Sequential Decision Making
items.abstract_or_text: Puzzles are widely used to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) systems for sequential decision making, yet approaches originating from different paradigms are rarely compared under unified conditions. To address this gap, we introduce a three-dimensional characterization framework that enables the analysts of AI methods by 1) projecting them to the Markov decision process (MDP) sequential decision making formalism, 2) degree of autonomy through human prior ranking of their designs and, 3) skill and computational cost. Using this framework, we analyze how representative graph-based, reinforcement learning, and large language model (LLM)-based approaches differ in their design choices and performance characteristics, instantiated respectively by Neurosolver, forward-backward reinforcement learning (FBRL), and automated thought-of-search (AutoToS), including a double-agent extension of thought-of-search (DA-ToS). The analysis relies on the Tower of Hanoi puzzle that provides a controlled benchmark with well-defined rules and scalable complexity, enabling consistent comparison across increasing problem sizes. The 3D characterization reveals that LLM-based methods, due to their weakly constrained action-space design, shift complexity from architecture to inference-time verification, leading to substantially higher memory and runtime costs than Neurosolver and FBRL.
items.summary_zh: 论文以汉诺塔为规则明确、难度可扩展的受控任务，比较图方法、强化学习和 LLM 方法，并从 MDP 表述、自主程度、技能与计算成本三个维度刻画顺序决策。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 统一比较显示，所考察的 LLM 方法把较多复杂度转移到推理时验证，内存和运行时成本高于所比较的 Neurosolver 与 FBRL；这是一项受控任务上的比较结论。
items.abstract_zh: 谜题被广泛用于评估人工智能（AI）系统在顺序决策中的推理能力，但源自不同范式的方法很少在统一条件下比较。为弥补这一空白，我们引入一个三维刻画框架，它通过以下方面支持对 AI 方法的分析：1）将其投射到马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的顺序决策形式化；2）通过对其设计进行人类先验排序来衡量自主程度；3）衡量技能和计算成本。利用该框架，我们分析了代表性的图方法、强化学习和大语言模型（LLM）方法在设计选择和性能特征上的差异，分别以 Neurosolver、前向后向强化学习（FBRL）和自动化思维搜索（AutoToS）为实例，其中还包括思维搜索的双智能体扩展（DA-ToS）。分析依赖于汉诺塔谜题；该谜题具有定义明确的规则和可扩展的复杂度，从而可以在不断增大的问题规模上进行一致比较。三维刻画显示，由于动作空间设计约束较弱，基于 LLM 的方法将复杂度从架构转移至推理时验证，导致其内存和运行时成本显著高于 Neurosolver 和 FBRL。
items.author_line: Sadig Gojayev, Carolina Fortuna

items.title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
items.abstract_or_text: Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 13 个选择题基准上将专用决策模型 Jev 与 19 个通用 LLM 比较；Jev 在 MathQA 上低于前沿模型中位数 17.7 分，且低于全部 19 个 LLM。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果把知识型选择决策与需要多步计算的数学文字题区分开来，避免将某些选择题成绩泛化为数学推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: Jev 是一个“系统一”模型，它返回给定选项中的一个选择，而不生成文本。我们研究这种专用决策模型与通用大语言模型（LLM）相比表现如何。我们在覆盖知识、推理和多语言理解的 13 个选择题基准上评估 Jev，并将其与三个层级中的 19 个 LLM 比较：前沿、代表性和小型。Jev 在知识和常识基准上可与前沿 LLM 竞争，并在 MMLU-Redux 和 ARC-Challenge 上获得最高分。在数学之外，它也优于大多数代表性 LLM 和全部小型 LLM。然而，它在数学文字题上落后：在 MathQA 上，它比前沿模型中位数低 17.7 分，并且得分低于全部 19 个 LLM。这些结果表明，专用决策模型能够在主要依赖知识的决策上匹配通用 LLM，但不能在需要多步计算的决策上做到这一点。
items.author_line: Xing Li, Qingcheng Chang, Jinzhong Ning, Changfeng Xu, Shenlong Zhang, Yijia Zhang, Ling Luo, Hongfei Lin

items.title: SpatialOPSD: Self-Distilling Spatial Intelligence from Verified Coding Agent Traces
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial coding agents significantly improve spatial reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by using external tools to generate verified execution traces. However, this paradigm inherently suffers from prohibitive inference-time overhead and external dependencies. In this paper, we explore whether an MLLM can internalize this agentic capability to operate entirely tool-free. We begin with a simple observation: prompting an MLLM with summarized execution traces of a spatial coding agent naturally unlocks the model's internal spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Motivated by this, we introduce SpatialOPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that internalizes spatial reasoning into a standalone MLLM by formulating verified agent traces as privileged information. To mitigate privileged-information leakage during distillation, we introduce Repetition-Aware Distillation, which combines repetition masking with unlikelihood regularization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that self-distilling SpatialOPSD achieves higher average accuracy than SFT and GRPO on both spatial and OOD datasets, exhibiting superior performance and generalization.
items.summary_zh: SpatialOPSD 把空间编码智能体产生的已验证执行轨迹作为特权信息，蒸馏进无需工具的多模态大语言模型，并在多个空间与分布外数据集上与 SFT、GRPO 比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究的结论限定于所述空间基准：已验证轨迹可作为训练信号，论文报告其蒸馏模型在这些评测上优于两个比较训练方案。
items.abstract_zh: 空间编码智能体通过使用外部工具生成已验证的执行轨迹，显著提升了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的空间推理能力。然而，这一范式天然面临高昂的推理时开销和外部依赖。本文探究 MLLM 是否能够将这种智能体能力内化，从而完全在无工具条件下运行。我们从一个简单观察出发：向 MLLM 提供空间编码智能体的摘要执行轨迹，会自然激发模型内部的空间思维链（CoT）。受此启发，我们提出 SpatialOPSD，这是一种在策略自蒸馏框架；它将已验证的智能体轨迹作为特权信息，把空间推理内化到独立的 MLLM 中。为缓解蒸馏过程中的特权信息泄漏，我们引入重复感知蒸馏，将重复掩码与非似然正则化结合。多个基准上的实验表明，经过自蒸馏的 SpatialOPSD 在空间数据集和分布外数据集上的平均准确率均高于 SFT 和 GRPO，并表现出更好的性能与泛化。
items.author_line: Rongxue Li, Meng Yang, Yiru Mao, Yongliang Tao, Lulu Hu, Bin Yang, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Bowen Xu

items.title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.
items.summary_zh: GPD 在空间推理训练中把深度、语义与鸟瞰图几何线索作为特权信息；部署时仍只使用 RGB，并在四个空间推理基准的平均分及消融中与 GRPO、answer-privileged OPSD 比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文明确报告了训练时可得几何证据与部署时 RGB 输入之间的边界；其优势仅是在所述 4B 骨干和空间基准设置下得到验证。
items.abstract_zh: 空间推理仍是视觉语言模型（VLM）的持续弱点，因为 RGB 输入并不直接提供几何证据。现有补救方法要么在推理时向模型注入 3D 信息，付出架构和延迟成本；要么使用仅监督最终答案的结果奖励进行训练。空间错误起源于感知：对深度或方向的误判只能由场景的真实几何结构纠正，而空间训练语料的 3D 扫描来源已经提供了这些结构。我们提出 GPD（Geometry-Privileged Distillation，几何特权蒸馏），它将几何证据设为在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中的特权信息。对于每个问题，深度、语义和鸟瞰图（BEV）线索被渲染为紧凑文本，并与参考答案一起路由给教师模型；仅应用于错误轨迹的特权 KL 项增强 GRPO，而部署模型保持只使用 RGB。在 4B 骨干上，GPD 在 VSI-Bench 上获得 57.1 分，并在 MindCube、SPARBench、MMSI-Bench 和 ViewSpatial 上平均获得 37.6 分，优于 GRPO 和 answer-privileged OPSD。消融实验确认了 3D 特权与答案特权的互补性、问题条件路由相对完整上下文注入的优势，以及将蒸馏限制于错误轨迹的益处。
items.author_line: Hongxing Li, Yixin Li, Dingming Li, Zixuan Wang, Yuchen Yan, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Yongliang Shen

items.title: Beyond Imitation: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Peer Review
items.abstract_or_text: The rapid growth of scientific publishing has strained peer review, particularly in machine learning, raising concerns about declining review quality and increasing reviewer workload. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as automated review assistants, yet their evaluation has focused largely on imitating human-written reviews rather than supporting the core functions of peer review. Here, we introduce a verification-centric perspective on LLM-assisted peer review, emphasizing error detection as a critical and resource-intensive task. We present a scalable benchmark that evaluates review systems' ability to identify logical contradictions, constructed through synthetic insertion of errors into conference papers, yielding unambiguous evaluation targets and enabling systematic comparison. We further propose a Multi-Layered Review (MLR) framework that prioritizes detailed manuscript comprehension before review generation, aligning more closely with human reviewing practices while improving token efficiency. Across evaluations, our approach demonstrates strong alignment with human review scores, achieves high error detection performance, and provides complementary perspectives on reviewer focus. These improvements can be attributed to both the choice of the underlying LLM and the design of our system. At the same time, we corroborate persistent vulnerabilities to adversarial manipulation, underscoring the need for robustness in automated review systems. Our findings highlight the importance of rigorous, error-focused evaluation to guide responsible deployment of LLM-based tools in peer review and other critical scientific workflows.

items.abstract_zh: 科学出版的快速增长已使同行评审承压，尤其是在机器学习领域，引发了对评审质量下降和评审者工作量增加的担忧。大语言模型（LLM）被提出作为自动评审助手，但其评估在很大程度上集中于模仿人类撰写的评审，而非支持同行评审的核心功能。本文提出一种以验证为中心的 LLM 辅助同行评审视角，强调错误检测是一项关键且资源密集的任务。我们提出一个可扩展的基准，通过向会议论文中合成插入错误来评估评审系统识别逻辑矛盾的能力；这产生了无歧义的评估目标，并支持系统比较。我们还提出 Multi-Layered Review（MLR）框架，在生成评审前优先进行细致的稿件理解；该框架更接近人类评审实践，同时提高了 token 效率。跨评估结果显示，我们的方法与人类评审分数具有较强一致性，实现了较高的错误检测性能，并为评审者关注点提供了互补视角。这些改进既可归因于底层 LLM 的选择，也可归因于系统设计。同时，我们证实了自动化评审系统持续存在对抗操纵脆弱性，强调此类系统需要具备鲁棒性。研究结果突显了严格、以错误为中心的评估对于指导 LLM 工具在同行评审及其他关键科学工作流中负责任部署的重要性。
